   [31m├[0m [41;37m    (function createToggles() {                                          [0m

   [31m├[0m [41;37m                if (e.target.closest('a, span[data-clipboard-text], .sf-toggle') !== toggle) {[0m

   [31m├[0m [41;37m    (function createFilters() {                                          [0m
